attack_sample.per_category: 30 for 8 categories; Worms 23 (shortfall 7, recorded, not filled)
attack_sample.flow_types: 208 TCP, 55 other (all 55 are short no-reply flows)
attack_sample.rule: protocol step6-v3-draft-1 attack_sample, implementation fixed in experiments/unsw_v3_attack_sample.py

discarded_draws.93a0f50e163f0c71d1d30a275ad26ad76322e5d4: first draw excluded row positions instead of official ids; never used; rejected by src/unsw/v3_sample.py

attack_sample.loader: src/unsw/v3_sample.load_frozen_sample (refuses any file whose CSV hash, digest, size or identity checks differ)

explanations.lime: src/unsw/v3_explain.py: LimeTabularExplainer, 5,000 samples, quartile discretizer, kernel width sqrt(n_features)*0.75, feature_selection none, Ridge surrogate, label attack, one RandomState(seed) reset per explanation; explainer statistics from the v3 training side; feature space = the model's own features (42 or 39)
explanations.treeshap: RF: TreeExplainer(model, background) interventional, probability; XGBoost: TreeExplainer(booster, background, tree_path_dependent, raw log-odds); 100-row background from the v3 training side, default_rng(42); one-hot columns summed into raw features; additivity checked per flow (1e-4)
explanations.mlp_shap: no TreeSHAP; MLP is explained by LIME only (KernelSHAP not part of v3 unless amended)
explanations.rankings: |weight| descending, ties by feature name; metrics compare only features the model uses (no artificial zero-weight TTL ties); tie-aware Spearman reported alongside
explanations.cache: identity-keyed (explainer, model SHA-256, feature set, settings hash, seed, vector hash over the model's features); resumable

treeshap_background.source: v3 training side, sorted official order, numpy default_rng(42) choice without replacement

success_criteria.lime: D8 unchanged: still attack AND within policy AND held-out top-10 Jaccard AND Spearman both below the original's held-out seed-pair minimum AND (physical_v1) status consistent_with_checked_rules; confirmed on seeds 401-404 (D14)
success_criteria.treeshap: D11 unchanged (cross-explainer bar), reported for continuity
success_criteria.unverified: candidates with unverified_dependencies are reported separately, never counted as successes
success_criteria.g4: diagnostic only, never a realizable attack

DEF1.definition: LIME averaged over seeds 301-305; evaluated against the G2 adaptive attacker
DEF1.report: success with and without the defense, extra explanation cost

DEF2.definition: consistency check flagging an alert when SHAP-vs-LIME disagreement or LIME seed instability exceeds the clean-flow band
DEF2.calibration: clean v3 validation flows not in the sample (proposal: 300 normal + 300 attack, default_rng(2026))
DEF2.report: detection of E0/G4 manipulated explanations and false-alarm rate on clean flows

rq5.primary: descriptive: per (model, flow, candidate) the same metrics for LIME (mean over held-out seeds) and TreeSHAP, each against its own original (top-10 Jaccard, Spearman, tie-aware Spearman, top-1 change); paired by flow; medians with bootstrap 95% intervals (10,000 resamples, seed 2026)
rq5.sensitivity: TreeSHAP background resampling (interventional XGBoost as an extra labelled configuration); not a noise threshold

ttl_ablation.design: same 263 flows, full42 vs no_ttl39 models of the same family (option A, independently tuned)
ttl_ablation.report: per-flow success and RQ5 metrics, paired by flow; exact McNemar on discordant flows (descriptive unless declared confirmatory)

statistics.P2: unchanged definition (Wilcoxon signed-rank over flows, Holm within its family); family = the predeclared G1 comparisons
statistics.exploratory: everything not listed here is exploratory and labelled as such
statistics.strata: results reported by attack category, flow type (TCP/other) and tier

tests.proportions: Wilson 95% primary, Clopper-Pearson 95% secondary, per variant x budget x status group, unit = flow
tests.P2: Wilcoxon signed-rank over flows, two-sided, Holm within the predeclared family (family fixed with D-v3-10 before the search runs)
tests.ttl_ablation: exact McNemar on discordant flows, descriptive
tests.rq5: paired differences per flow, medians with bootstrap 95% intervals (10,000 resamples, seed 2026), descriptive

parallelism: single process unless a parallel-safety benchmark (time, memory, bit-identical results vs single process) is run and approved first

research_questions.RQ1: Can LIME or TreeSHAP explanations be manipulated while the attack is still detected? E0 (constrained, physical_v1) and G4 (diagnostic upper bound), reported separately
research_questions.RQ2: How much do realistic constraints reduce manipulation? E0/G1 (physical_v1) vs G3 (current_v1) vs G4 (unconstrained), same flows
research_questions.RQ3: Do RF, XGBoost and MLP (LR secondary) differ? all variants on the same 263 flows
research_questions.RQ4: Can a defense help without hurting detection? DEF-1 against the G2 adaptive attacker; DEF-2 detection and false-alarm rate
research_questions.RQ5: How does explanation robustness differ between LIME and TreeSHAP? matched descriptive metrics on identical candidates (E0); TreeSHAP background sensitivity

limitations: physical_v1 status 'consistent_with_checked_rules' means consistent with formulas checked on the training data, not physically valid; no candidate is ever called physically valid
packet-timing dependencies (sinpkt, sjit after spkts edits) cannot be verified and are reported as unverified_dependencies, never counted as successes
no packet-level validation has been done yet (WS4b: Argus/Zeek); until then results are feature-space results
G4 successes are diagnostic manipulation, never a realizable attack
grouped random CV is not chronological validation; the time-split robustness study (S2) is separate and postponed
the sample is all tier 1 (unique vectors) and mostly TCP sessions; results are reported by category and flow type
